description: Modal dialog for comparing two document sources - the current document, another document by id, or an uploaded DOCX snapshot - running a provider or local comparison and rendering the result via TmDocumentDiffViewer, with loading, empty, and error states.

parameters.name: DocumentProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to resolve document id sources for local comparison.

parameters.name: FormatProvider
parameters.description: Optional external format provider used for DOCX upload comparison sources.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog should close.

parameters.name: UseLocalComparisonFallback
parameters.description: Whether local comparison should be used when the provider fails.

parameters.name: OnExportRedline
parameters.description: Raised when the user asks to export the current comparison as a redline (tracked-changes) document. The button renders only when the callback is wired and the result has changes.
